Settings.enableMobileHint: Switch to the mobile-optimized UI on touch devices.
Settings.forceMobileHint: Override device detection. Useful for testing on a desktop browser.
Settings.hideNativeUIHint: Hides the sidebar, scene navigation, hotbar and player list so the map fills the screen.
Settings.hideQuickControlsHint: Hides the floating quick control buttons.
Settings.enableChatStackHint: Automatically pop up a floating card on screen when a new roll or chat message arrives.
Settings.touchFeedbackHint: Buttons react the moment you touch them instead of waiting for the browser's click, which is what makes a touch screen feel like a mouse.
Settings.touchHapticsHint: A short buzz when a control is pressed. Ignored on devices without a vibration motor.
Settings.keepScreenAwakeHint: Stops the phone from dimming and locking during play. Released automatically when you switch tabs.
Settings.enableCanvasFreezeHint: Freezes canvas rendering when idle to save battery and prevent heating.
Settings.sheetOnlyModeHint: Disables the map canvas entirely and shows a static background plus an optional radar. Use this when iOS keeps reloading the tab. Reloads the page.
Settings.canvasFreezeDelayHint: How long the canvas must be idle before rendering stops.
Settings.vramLimitWarningHint: Warn when estimated texture VRAM exceeds this amount (400MB suits iOS).
Settings.imageOptimizerThresholdHint: Scene images larger than this are flagged by the image optimizer.
